items.title: 95 The Grasshoppers 2027 Build Thread
items.summary: Welcome to the 2027 Grasshoppers build thread! We will be publishing code, CAD, videos, and journal posts throughout the season. This first post will be a Wiki. If there is a post you especially like please feel free to add a link to it here. Onshape link TBD Youtube Github 3 posts - 1 participant Read full topic

items.title: Should I run vision on the coming SystemCore?
items.summary: Our team uses two OV9281 cameras, and I bought a raspberry pi 5 two years back to run these cameras with PhotonVision. With the coming SystemCore, should I leave my pi on the robot, or will the SystemCore be able to juggle robot code and two camera processes at the same time? I know it might be early to ask, but I’m hoping maybe some of the early testers might have insight. 14 posts - 11 participa…
